notes.title: End of the Year Announcement 2024
notes.content:
Hey there!

2024 has been slow content-wise, but we've been working on multiple aspects of the last three levels at the same time, so things should move quicker from now on. Additionally, we've put a lot of effort into improving older levels and assets to bring them up to our current standards. Time has also been spent on figuring out the broad strokes of our next project, and we're moving towards the first prototype with it.

We'll begin next year by finishing Level 18 and continuing work on Levels 19 and 20. Shortly after releasing Level 18, we'll also start building a prototype for our next project. The next project will be a bit different from White Hell, and we're excited to show you more!

Happy new year and stay tuned!

notes.content:

notes.title: End of the Year News
notes.content:
2021 will soon be over, and we thought you might want to hear how development is going!

It's always better to show than tell, so here's a video featuring gameplay from Level 11, which marks the beginning of Chapter 3:

[previewyoutube=i1aDN6CyV-s;full][/previewyoutube]

Another Dimension:
The end of Chapter 2 had Jarmo bust through a portal, which lead him to the source of his troubles. It's up to you to fight your way through this corrupted land of myth and hopefully get back to Finland.

Whole New Faction of Enemies:
Tuoni, the local God of Death, has his forces ready to stop Jarmo. So far they include the dual-sword wielding Cultists, small nuisances known as Hiisi, and superb guard dogs, the ironbound HURT-TA units.

New SISU Weapon:
Use the OCULUS RIFLE to tag multiple enemies at once, and let the gibs hit the floor.


After our Early Access launch in August, we have received lots of great feedback regarding all aspects of the game. General quality of life improvements, such as aim assist, toggleable crouch/sprint, and smoother weapon switching are on the way and will drop with content updates.

The next content patch will include the first three levels of Chapter three, with more details coming in early 2022. The best places to follow for regular updates are our Twitter and Discord, as we post nearly weekly gameplay snippets, screenshots, and teasers for upcoming content.


Thank you all for supporting our game and have a great new year!
